title: Typed for loop invalidates checking if the type is correct
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible since typed loops were introduced in 4.2, tested in the following versions:
v4.7.dev2.official [778cf54da]
v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e]
v4.4.stable.official [4c311cbee]
v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8]
v4.2.2.stable.official [15073afe3]
v4.2.stable.official [46dc27791]

### System information

Godot v4.2.stable - Windows 10.0.19045 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6070) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-8700K CPU @ 3.70GHz (12 Threads)

### Issue description

When using a typed for loop over an array of mixed items, for instance `get_children()` you can no longer check to see if the current element actually *is* of the expected type. That's to say, the for loop assigns the wrong type into the variable and then optimises away the if statement since it's a known type.

Assume the children are of mixed types such as Label and Button and we want to disable the buttons:
```gdscript
for button: Button in get_children():
	if button != null and button is Button:
		button.disabled = true # BUG: This line breaks at runtime
```
This fails on the line marked with the following error: _ready: Trying to assign value of type 'Label' to a variable of type 'Button'.

I'd expect that it assigns null to the variable button, just like you would get if you used the `as` operator. _Or_ that it performs the `button is Button` check, despite the type making it seem a pointless comparison. _Or_ that you get a warning about the `is Button` check not being performed since the variable is typed. That way when the error happens you have a warning ahead of time. It's a little odd the error occurs on the third line rather than the for loop itself, but that is a lesser issue than the fact that the code looks like it would work but it doesn't without any warnings.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a Control in a scene
2. Add a Button and a Label as children
3. Add a script to the parent Control with:
```gdscript
func _ready() -> void:
	for button: Button in get_children():
		if button != null and button is Button:
			button.disabled = true # BUG: This line breaks at runtime
```
4. Run this scene

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[bugtest-4.2-4.7.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26147055/bugtest-4.2-4.7.zip)
